coverage_decisions: Every graded recommendation and Practice Point in the guideline summary was atomized once.
Research recommendations were represented as author_conclusion atoms.
Underlying trial and meta-analysis findings summarized by KDIGO were used for SEA evidence reconciliation and were not promoted to primary-study atoms.
All 5 main figures, 9 main tables, and 65 supplement tables were inventoried after rendered-page review.
The bibliography was extracted separately and not atomized.

source_integrity_issues.location: Main guideline reference 86 versus Data Supplement reference for DAPA-CKD IgAN analysis
source_integrity_issues.issue: The main guideline prints the Wheeler et al. Kidney International citation as volume 388, pages 117-127, while the data supplement prints Kidney International 2021;100:215-224.
source_integrity_issues.handling: The discrepancy is preserved. The Markdown bibliography reproduces the main guideline entry as printed; the SEA flags the conflict without silently correcting it.
